faq_heading: Neilsen Grove condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Neilsen Grove sell for?
faq.a: 23 townhomes sold in Neilsen Grove between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,090,000.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Neilsen Grove?
faq.a: The median was 45 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (13% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Neilsen Grove sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 23 townhomes that sold in Neilsen Grove went for between $920,000 and $1,195,000, around a median of $1,090,000.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Neilsen Grove sell above asking price?
faq.a: 13% of the 23 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.4% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Neilsen Grove?
faq.a: Of the 23 sales, 23 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $410.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Neilsen Grove?
faq.a: The median year built was 2017 for the 23 townhomes sold in Neilsen Grove.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Neilsen Grove usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Neilsen Grove had 3 bedrooms, from the 23 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Neilsen Grove condos and townhomes for sale now
What Neilsen Grove condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

23 townhomes sold in Neilsen Grove with a median price of $1,090,000 (the middle half sold between $920,000 and $1,195,000), taking a median of 45 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 13% sold above list. They had a median $598 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $410 a month. 9 condos sold in Neilsen Grove with a median price of $840,000 (the middle half sold between $784,000 and $925,000), taking a median of 47 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $746 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $597 a month.

blocks.text: How Neilsen Grove compares with the rest of Ladner

The median townhome in Neilsen Grove sold for $1,090,000, 22% above the Ladner median of $890,000 across 62 sales. Neilsen Grove townhomes took a median 45 days to sell, against 38 days for Ladner as a whole.
